cleavage agent: Samples were mixed with trypsin and digested at 37 °C overnight.
enrichment method: Supernatants, clarified by centrifugation, were incubated with an anti-FLAG affinity gel (Sigma-Aldrich, USA) for 18 h at 4 °C.
instrument: Orbitrap Q Exactive HF-X mass spectrometer
coupled with an Orbitrap Q Exactive HF-X mass spectrometer (Thermo Invitrogen, USA)
labeling: the remaining 90% (vol/vol) volume of eluted proteins was subjected to liquid chromatography tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS) analysis to identify coimmunoprecipitated host proteins.
ptm: dynamical modifications: oxidation (M); fixed modifications: carbamidomethyl: (C)
